mapper.sql: f.id, f.user_id, f.target_type, f.target_id, f.favorite_time, f.create_by, f.update_by, f.create_time, f.update_time, CASE f.target_type WHEN 1 THEN p.product_name WHEN 2 THEN st.store_name WHEN 3 THEN b.brand_name END AS target_name, u.nickname, u.username

FROM shop_consumer_favorite f LEFT JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = f.target_id AND f.target_type = 1 AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = f.target_id AND f.target_type = 2 AND st.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN shop_brand b ON b.id = f.target_id AND f.target_type = 3 AND b.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.user_id
